risk_if_not_implemented: Without Data Protection Officer (DPO), sensitive and/or regulated data may be disclosed, altered or lost through inadequate classification, handling or protection. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Regulatory / Legal / Contractual Financial Liability (R-EX-5), Unperformed / Unowned Control Responsibilities (R-GV-3), Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), Loss of Critical Knowledge / Capability (R-PE-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Statutory / Regulatory / Contractual Change (MT-11), Conflict of Interest (COI) / Undue Influence / Insider Misconduct (MT-15), Workforce Shortage / Loss of Critical Skills / Labor Disruption (MT-25).

compensating_control_1.name: Personal Data (PD) Control Testing, Training & Monitoring
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to conduct testing, training and monitoring activities for Personal Data (PD) controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Personal Data (PD) Control Testing, Training & Monitoring (PRI-11) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Data Protection Officer (DPO) (PRI-03.2) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the people-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Conformity Monitoring
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to validate that Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) conform to the organization's security, compliance and/or resilience policies, standards and other applicable requirements.
compensating_control_2.justification: Conformity Monitoring (CPL-05) provides periodic assessment and assurance that compensates for the absence of Data Protection Officer (DPO) (PRI-03.2) by providing structured evaluation of the environment to surface gaps and verify residual control effectiveness. Given the people-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
